detail.longDescription: A few weeks ago, my musician friend Sknob released a song and video, “Do something”. It reminded me about sharing here how the manual and artistic activities I am doing not-for-a-living deeply improve my research process, my mental health, and how they ground me in reality too — which is, let’s be honest, quite essential in the times we are living in for a person doing most of their work with […] https://lookingup.francois-rincon.org/the-merits-of-doing-something-else/
